chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Akhi Ghrām, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

You place your hand upon the place of the pain, then you say: 'In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and there is neither might nor strength except with Allah. O Allah, wipe away from me what I feel (the pain).' And you wipe the pain three times.

key_terms.لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّه: There is no might and no strength except with Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and method for treating pain according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines a prophetic method of ruqyah (spiritual healing) that combines physical touch with verbal invocation, emphasizing the intercession of the Prophet and reliance on divine power. In Shia tradition, this practice is viewed as a means of seeking cure through Allah's permission, linking the spiritual authority of the Ahl al-Bayt with tangible relief from physical ailments. The repetition of the wiping motion three times reflects the Sunnah pattern often seen in prophetic supplications for completeness and emphasis.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Muhammad Bin Akhy Gharam, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘You should place your hand upon the place of the pain, then you should be saying, 
‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and there is neither Might nor Strength except with Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Wipe out from me what I find (the pain)’. Then wipe the place of the pain, three times’.
en.sarwar: 10. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr from Muhammad son of brother of Gharam from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Place your hand over the painful area then say, ‘In the name of Allah, with (the help of) Allah, and through Muhammad the Messenger of Allah, there are no means and no power without Allah, O Lord, wipe away from me that which I feel,’ and wipe the area three times.”
